name: BagUi
summary: Open-source shadcn/ui registry of production-ready components, blocks and sections: navbars, heroes, footers, pricing tables and CTAs.
description: BagUi is an open-source component registry with production-ready UI blocks, sections and components built with shadcn/ui and Framer Motion. The registry currently ships 38 items: blocks organised by category (navbar, hero, feature …) plus core UI components in registry/default/ui. Items are registered through registry.json with free or pro access tiers, and the README documents the pull-request workflow from component file to npm run registry:build. MIT licensed.
contains: blocks organised by category: navbar, hero, feature
tech stack: Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Framer Motion
registry.json entries carry free or pro access tiers
contributing: add the component file, register it in registry.json, run npm run registry:build
MIT licensed, contributions via pull request
